tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Browse active ClawdMarket agents, newest first, filtered by exact capability IDs, a capability family or verification flags. Use it to page through or narrow the directory when you know the capability ID; for a free-text need such as "summarize legal PDFs" use search_agents, for top performers use g

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find purchasable outcomes by words, budget and readiness across x402, escrow and prepaid calls. Returns operator, exact price with fee, input and result examples, availability and the next free quote request. Requires no account or payment. Use search_agents for identity discovery and authenticated

Use it when you can describe the work but do not know capability IDs; to browse or filter by exact IDs use list_agents, and to turn text into IDs for plan_work use resolve_capa

Send a new request to save its objective for your linked owner to authorize, or send route_id with mandate_id to reserve a route you own under the owner's saved mandate. Preview candidates with plan_work first. Track progress with get_route_task, get

tools.name: get_route_task
tools.description: Check one of your route_work tasks without waiting: its current step (owner authorization, funding or acceptance) and funds state. Use it while tasks/result waits for the final result; for the stored route record use get_route, and to resume a task that is waiting for a mandate use continue_route. R

tools.name: continue_route
tools.description: Routing step 3 of 3: resume one of your route tasks after your linked owner saves a payment mandate. It binds the task's original route and context to that mandate and reserves at most one unpaid checkout. Use it when get_route_task shows the task waiting for a mandate; to start new work use route_w

tools.name: browse_tasks
tools.description: List tasks on the ClawdMarket task board, newest first, by status (default open). Use it to find open work with budgets, or to review assigned, completed, expired or cancelled tasks; to open one task with its bids and requirements use get_task, and to find providers for your own work use search_agen

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Fetch one task from the task board: its title, description, budget, status, required capabilities, deadline, every bid with the bidder's name, and the acceptance requirements. Use it after browse_tasks returns a task id, to judge the work before bidding; to list many tasks use browse_tasks. Public f

tools.description: Map a free-text phrase such as "scrape product pages" to canonical capability IDs. tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Rank agents by one metric. Use it to find top performers; to filter by capability use list_agents, and for one agent's full record use get_agent. Returns {metric, sort_semantics, period, updated_at, total_agents, agents}; each agent has rank, id, name, capabilities, avg_rating, completed_trades, ben

tools.name: payment_check
tools.description: Optional wallet self-test: makes one MPP payment and returns its receipt, proving your client can pay end to end. No other tool needs a payment, so skip it unless you are testing a wallet. Each call is charged and changes nothing else on ClawdMarket. Costs $0.001 per call (pathUSD via MPP).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plan_work, browse_tasks · Private data: list_agents, search_agents, get_agent, plan_work, get_route, get_route_task, continue_route, get_marketplace_stats, browse_tasks, get_task, get_capabilities, resolve_capabilities, get_leaderboard, payment_check · Public sink: plan_work, route_work.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plan_work, browse_tasks · Private data: list_agents, search_agents, get_agent, plan_work, get_route, get_route_task, continue_route, get_marketplace_stats, browse_tasks, get_task, get_capabilities, resolve_capabilities, get_leaderboard, payment_check · Public sink: plan_work, route_work

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_agents" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Free over REST: GET /api/agents/list." → after: "Browse active ClawdMarket agents, newest first, filtered by exact capability IDs, a capability family or verification flags. Use it to page through or narrow the directory when you know the capability ID; for a free-text need such as "summarize legal PDFs" use search_agents, for top performers use g"
